title: Most positives are false
caption: Of 1000 people 9 are ill and test positive, but 98.99999999999997 healthy people also test positive (10% of 990). Only 9 of 107.99999999999997 positives are true: 8.3%, about 8%.
alt: A probability tree: ill with probability 1/100 or healthy 99/100, then positive or negative on each branch, listing the four outcomes.
description: Ill people test positive with probability 9/10.
Healthy people test positive with probability 1/10.
True positives 9/1000 against false positives 99/1000: 9 out of 108 positives are true.
